systems.country_label: منظومة السجل المدني / قاعدة بيانات السجل المدني
systems.platform: not named; the source code is said not to have passed fully into state ownership
systems.owner: Civil Status Authority (مصلحة الأحوال المدنية), Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: civil registry offices, put at 160 in all; office heads, section heads, clerks and IT staff are said to be able to enter changes into the official record

systems.system: Modern digital system to prevent forgery
systems.owner: Attorney General's office with the competent bodies

note: Sahra Intelligence's analysis of 66 Attorney General releases to April 2026. It describes weaknesses of the registry database (no audit server, no multi-stage approval of data entry and amendment, manual authentication of documents, late closure of deceased persons' records, source code not fully state-owned) and counts 160 civil registry offices, but does not state where or how a birth or death is entered, so no aspect takes a value.
